analysis: The PR changes documentation only: docs/developer/test.md (head lines ~958-963 and the Console section at 1084-1088) and docs/reference/configuration.md (head lines 5-7 and the Console UI section at 84-85). It removes the retained-console test instructions and the NEXT_PUBLIC_* build-time variable table, replacing them with pointers to the platform repository's console ownership. No code, protocol, key custody, attestation, cache, or authorization behavior changes. No threat-model asset, boundary, or mitigation is weakened. Removing the console guidance does not invalidate any retained threat (T-041 and the TB-002/003/007/009/011/012 entries concern provider-side behavior, unchanged here). Unit 8d39ffcfaa638a3c:0 is a metadata-only entry with no text. It was acknowledged and has no visible lines to cite. The docs/reference/configuration.md patch excerpt in file_changes is truncated, but the full patch unit shows the whole change. Remaining docs lines about the add-on hold socket, endpoint resumption, App Attest worker opt-ins, and logout are unchanged context and were not re-assessed. One minor documentation observation: the base text still links to ../architecture/components/console-ui.md, and I cannot verify from the supplied evidence that the target page was updated to match the new platform-owned wording. That is a docs consistency question, not a security regression. A fixture-ownership sentence in test.md was reworded and may read slightly oddly after the edit. It has no security effect.
